title: Ansatsu Kyoushitsu: Jump Festa 2013 Special
synopsis:
Jump Super Anime Tour 2013 (ジャンプスーパーアニメツアー2013) event, traveled to five cities throughout Japan from October 6 to November 24, screened an exclusive anime adaptation of Matsui Yuusei's Ansatsu Kyoushitsu comedy manga.

(Source: Anime News Network)
